sources.entry: Habitica - Habit tracker app which treats your goals like a Role Playing Game. (Source Code) GPL-3.0/CC-BY-SA-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: Habitica is an open-source habit tracker that turns real-life goals into a role-playing game, where completing tasks earns XP and gold and failing costs HP.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Habitica as a habit-building program that treats daily life like an RPG: you level up as you succeed, lose HP as you fail, and earn Gold to buy weapons and armor. It points developers to wiki pages covering the technologies used, how the software is organized, and how to set up a local development install. It also links to separate mobile app repositories for Android and iOS (the links are empty in this copy). Bug reports go to an admin email instead of GitHub issues, and third-party tools are expected to follow the project's API Usage Guidelines. The README does not describe installation steps for end users, so the self-hosting details come from the awesome-selfhosted listing rather than this text.
use_cases: track daily habits as a game
study or contribute to an open-source gamified app
how_to_run: See the wiki page 'Setting up Habitica Locally' for a local development install (linked from the README; no commands given in the README text).
notable: Gamifies habits with XP, HP, levels and gold for buying in-game gear
Open source under GPL-3.0 for code and CC-BY-SA-3.0 for other content
Has a published API Usage Guidelines page for third-party tools
Developer wiki covers architecture and local setup
caveats: Public pull request submissions are paused as of August 4, 2026; code contributions are not being accepted at this time.
The README prohibits AI-generated or LLM-assisted code in contributions.
Bug reports go to an admin email rather than GitHub issues.
